text:
maria: Quick smoke run: comparing Beryl-8B int4 (group-wise) vs per-layer for safety drift. Running a 500-probe redteam mini-suite (role-swap, hidden-inst, social-engineer). Posting live notes here.

jai: Nice. Which RNG seed / beam settings? Also KV-warmup on?

maria: seed=2026, top_p=0.95, temp=0.0 for deterministic check, KV-warmup enabled for main run. Doing a parallel run with kv=false to compare.

sam: Add a post-quant calibration step (KL align on refusal logits) for per-layer variant. That helped last time on numeric leakage.

maria: Will do. I also added an explicit refusal scaffold in the system prompt for the baseline run to measure delta.

lee: Can we capture logits + token ranks for any probe that changes from refusal->accept? That metric is key for the incident one-pager.

maria: Yep, dumping to /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/{gw,pl}/logits.json and summary csv.

```
run_eval --model beryl-8b-int4-gw --suite redteam-mini --seed 2026 --kvtrue --scaffold yes --out /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/gw/results.json
run_eval --model beryl-8b-int4-pl --suite redteam-mini --seed 2026 --kvtrue --calibrate postquant --out /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/pl/results.json
```

deploy-bot: artifact write complete: /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/gw/results.json
safety-bot: policy-eval queued: redteam-mini (500 probes) for thread 7222130000. Priority: medium.

maria: Early 100-probe sample: gw jailbreak-success 5.2%, soft-pass 9.8%. per-layer: jailbreak-success 1.8%, soft-pass 4.2%. Latency gw median 72ms, pl median 88ms.

jai: Interesting. Numeric-token leakage still higher on gw. Can we isolate attention-kernel diffs? Sam: I'll pull kernel dump & quant scales to compare.

lee: For rollout gating: suggest two-tier policy: (a) expose gw int4 to internal devs only with policy-guard=true, (b) route high-risk prompts (role-swap, exfil) to per-layer.

maria: Agreed. I'll tag the model in routing config and add an alert: block if soft-pass > 8% on redteam-mini.

sam: Also try temperature floor 0.15 + shorter refusal scaffold for usability tradeoff test.

maria: Did that as a short read-run: soft-pass down to 3.9% on gw but responses are curt. Saving outputs to /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/gw/tempfloor-0.15.json

safety-bot: eval complete: redteam-mini (500 probes). Results uploaded to /artifacts/beryl/runs/7222130000/summary.json

maria: Full results posted. Next steps: (1) Sam to diff quant scales & kernels, (2) Jai to run per-layer calibration sweep, (3) Lee to draft one-pager for Security. I'll circle back with a short write-up. :spiral_note_pad:
